## Method details

<a id="StringAssetLocator-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(Object handle)` 

If `true`, `handle` is a `String`.

<a id="StringAssetLocator-method-locate"></a>

### locate

`Asset locate(Object handle)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The asset … is not found in the classpath nor as a file, check the path or give a URL with its scheme (https:, file:, jar:)

Returns a [`UrlAsset`](/reference/resources/urlasset/) for a text that starts with a scheme of two letters or more (`https:`, `file:`, `jar:`), otherwise a [`ClasspathAsset`](/reference/resources/classpathasset/) when the classpath has the path, with or without a leading `/`, otherwise a [`FileAsset`](/reference/resources/fileasset/) when the path is a file on disk.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the path is found nowhere.
